# orionbelt_user (Data Source)

Look up a user by username.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "orionbelt_user" "engineer" {
  username = "eng-01"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `username` (String)

### Read-Only

- `email` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `mfa_enabled` (Boolean)
- `role` (String)
